title: A directed flat wall theorem excluding a crossrow grid
summary: The graph minor project contains the most influential results in recent undirected graph theory research. There has been progress in recent years in generalising some of their results to directed graphs, with the directed grid theorem of Kawarabayashi and Kreutzer [STOC '15] and the directed flat wall theorem of Giannopoulou, Kawarabayashi, Kreutzer, and Kwon [SODA '22]. We discuss the two different versions of the existing directed flat wall theorem and their drawbacks.
